title: Event Details

fields.label: Date
fields.name: kwv_event_date
fields.instructions: The date the event takes place. After this date the event automatically moves to Draft and drops out of the booking dropdowns. It stays live on the day itself.

fields.label: Accommodation nearby
fields.name: kwv_event_accommodation
fields.instructions: Optional — for larger events. Add places to stay from Booking.com, Airbnb, LekkeSlaap or any other site. When at least one is added, an "Accommodation nearby" section appears at the bottom of the event page. The platform (e.g. "via Airbnb") is detected from the link.

sub_fields.label: Link
sub_fields.name: url
sub_fields.instructions: The listing's web address, copied from the browser, e.g. https://www.airbnb.co.za/rooms/12345.

sub_fields.label: Name
sub_fields.name: title
sub_fields.instructions: The name shown on the card, e.g. "Le Franschhoek Hotel & Spa".

sub_fields.label: Image
sub_fields.name: image
sub_fields.instructions: Optional. A portrait photo (4:5) works best. Only use images you have permission to use. Without one, the card shows a branded panel with the platform name.

description: Custom fields for the Events (kwv_event) post type. The Brand (venue) link is a taxonomy, and the featured image is the native WordPress Featured Image. The Accommodation nearby repeater feeds the kwv/event-accommodation block. Managed as code in the KWV Enhancements plugin's /acf-json directory.
